import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
sleep_data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a bar chart for the distribution of sleep duration
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='Sleep Duration', y='Person ID', data=sleep_data, hue='Gender')
plt.title('Distribution of Sleep Duration by Gender')
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration')
plt.ylabel('Person ID')
plt.legend(title='Gender')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a heatmap for the correlation between physical activity and other health metrics
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
corr_matrix = sleep_data[['Physical Activity Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps', 'Stress Level']].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', square=True)
plt.title('Correlation between Physical Activity and Other Health Metrics')
plt.savefig('output2.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a boxplot for the distribution of sleep quality
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='Quality of Sleep', data=sleep_data)
plt.title('Distribution of Sleep Quality')
plt.xlabel('Sleep Quality')
plt.ylabel('Value')
plt.savefig('output3.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a scatter plot for the relationship between age and heart rate
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Age', y='Heart Rate', data=sleep_data)
plt.title('Relationship between Age and Heart Rate')
plt.xlabel('Age')
plt.ylabel('Heart Rate')
plt.savefig('output4.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
